title: jasminonerium macrocarpum
intro: Jasminonerium macrocarpum, commonly known as the "jasmine tree", is a species of flowering plant in the family Oleaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia due to its sedative and calming properties. The health benefits of Jasminonerium macrocarpum include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve mood, and provide antioxidant protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anxiolytic effects.
